### Coming Out of Babylon
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/coming-out-of-babylon
Passage: Revelation 18:4-5
Points:
- God's Word declares the certain and total downfall of corrupt powers opposed to Him.
- Just as Old Testament prophets foretold the ruin of pagan empires, Babylon will face desolate judgment.
- God urgently summons His people to come out of Babylon so they do not share in her sins and plagues.
- Believers must exercise constant vigilance to avoid absorbing the worldly culture and mindset around them.

### Will We Mourn for the Harlot Or Rejoice with Heaven?
Author: Wyatt Graham
Site: The Gospel Coalition Canada
URL: https://ca.thegospelcoalition.org/columns/detrinitate/will-we-mourn-for-the-harlot-or-rejoice-with-heaven/
Passage: Revelation 18:4
Points:
- Material comfort and ease can blind believers to their true spiritual poverty.
- Heaven's command to come out calls Christians to abandon corrupt systems of greed and luxury.
- While kings and merchants weep over Babylon's collapse, heaven rejoices in God's righteous judgment.
- Believers are challenged to examine their hearts and separate themselves from worldly allegiances.
